description_en: Degrades a video call to a voice call
description_zh: 从视频通话降级到语音通话
name: DegradeVideoFile

parameters.help_en: Call ID. Get the CallId from the return parameters of the SingleCallByVideo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm) interface
parameters.help_zh: 通话ID。您可以在SingleCallByVideo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm)接口返回参数中获取CallId
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en: Media type. The value is fixed as video
parameters.name: media_type

parameters.help_en:
ID reserved for the caller. The system returns this ID in the receipt message.

This is a string with a length of 1 to 15 bytes
parameters.help_zh:
预留给调用方使用的ID。最终会通过在回执消息中将此ID带回给调用方。

字符串类型，长度为1~15个字节
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en: The mobile phone number that receives the voice call
parameters.help_zh: 接收语音通知的手机号码
parameters.name: called_number
